description.tr: Zübeyid (Yemen'de) şehrinden bir tarihçi ve muhaddis. Doğumu ve vefatı orada gerçekleşmiştir.
description.en: A historian and hadith scholar from the city of Zabīd (in Yemen). He was born and died there.

transliteration.ar-Latn-x-alalc: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. ʿAlī b. Muḥammad al-Shaybānī al-Zaydī al-Shāfiʿī, Wajīh al-Dīn, known as Ibn al-Dībāʿ
